newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: DMCI to offer preferred shares.
newsitem.headline: DMCI to offer preferred shares.

text.p: Construction firm DMCI Holdings Inc said on Tuesday it would start offering 2.4 million preferred shares from March 17 to March 21.

The shares, which will be sold at 1,000 pesos each, will be convertible to common shares at a 10 percent premium to the average price of the share for a period of 15 days immediately preceding the start of the offer period, the company said in a statement to the Philippine Stock Exchange.
The issue date of the preferred share offer is April 7 and the stocks will be convertible from October 7, 1997 to March 7, 2002.
The company will have to buy back the preferred shares five years after the issue date. It can also redeem the shares starting from the second year.

The issue manager and lead underwriter is PCI Capital Corp. Its international selling agents are Merrill Lynch Far East Limited, Natwest Markets Corporate Finance Asia Limited and Santander Investment Securities Philippines Inc.
The proceeds of the offer will be be used to fund various infrastructure projects and acquisitions, the statement said.
